adjudication_summary: Source re-review closed rwk-complete-test-0001 by repairing the worker-2 activity target fields, adding SI Table S16 MIC rows, resolving DBAASP assay conflicts against primary/source-local tables, and replacing automated mechanism placeholders with non-overclaiming ontology context.

materials_exhausted.note: XML/NXML, extracted main-PDF text, OA package supplement PDF text, raw landing HTML supplementary assets, and filtered DBAASP rows were checked. No gate-relevant local source remains unopened.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: All 8 linked DBAASP assay rows and 8 linked experiment rows are source-supported after SI Table S16 was reopened; the literature row matches article metadata. The local snapshot has no sequence row, so sequence strings were not invented and the family-level DBAASP ID is carried as a caution.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Main Table 1 supports 12 IC50 rows against Plasmodium falciparum 3D7 with units and n=9 statistics; SI Table S16 supports 15 MIC rows (>20 µg/mL) for xylomyrocin A-C against bacterial/fungal test strains. Header text was removed from target species fields.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: The source supports phenotypic antiprotozoal activity and xylomyrocin biosynthetic machinery. It does not support a direct antimicrobial target/mechanism claim, so final ontology records remain contextual rather than direct-mechanism assertions.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_6_adjudication: The prior framework-test rework target is closed because source-local evidence now supports the repaired activity/database artifacts and no blocking/major QC issue remains.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DBAASP rows are verified for assay/citation values, but the local linked snapshot contains no linked_sequence_records row for DBAASPN_21740; no sequence normalization was attempted.
Activity is phenotypic antiprotozoal/MIC screening. Biosynthesis is source-supported, but no direct pathogen target or killing mechanism is assigned.
Raw supplementary landing-*.bin files are HTML landing pages; the OA package supplement PDF and extracted text contain the gate-relevant antimicrobial methods and Table S16.
